room-wall.note: Vertical gradient. The frontmatter value is the midpoint; the gradient pair is normative in src/scene/room.tsx.

room-floor.note: Vertical gradient. Frontmatter value is the midpoint.

daylight.note: Hard-edged polygon from the window at 55% opacity.

foliage.note: Leaves at 75% opacity on a #6fa894 stem.

oak.note: Electrical Adjustable Desk surface. Front face #cda478, side face #bc9165.

walnut.note: Mechanical Adjustable Desk surface. Front face #a87246, side face #94623b.

steel.note: Electrical desk column. Upper section #b9c0c6, foot #7f8890.

graphite.note: Mechanical desk frame and the electrical desk's control panel. Lighter member #586470.

mesh-slate.note: Ergonomic chair back. Frame #3e4a56, shell #46515c, weave #7a8794.

shell-terracotta.note: Compact Task Chair. Pad #da855c, stitch #a9532f, frame #4a4038. Marks the concept chair as visibly the odd one out.

headline.purpose: Page titles, and the live Setup rate, which is the builder's page title in all but grammar. One per screen.

title.purpose: Product names and labels naming a thing being chosen between.

caption.purpose: Descriptions, disclaimers, secondary help. Always Ink Muted.

label.purpose: Wordmark lockup second line and the Concept badge. Never an eyebrow above a heading.

shadows.name: scene-lift
shadows.purpose: The scene plate only. The largest lift in the system — the room is the one object with real physical presence.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: The catalog rail. Tighter and denser than scene-lift so it reads as sitting a little lower.

shadows.name: contact-shadow
shadows.purpose: Under every desk and chair inside the scene. Not a box-shadow — it is drawn geometry, so it skews with the room.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for every state transition.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and selection colour changes.

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Filters the catalog by Category. Bordered in both states so selection never shifts layout.
components.css: .ds-chip { font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink-muted, #6b6259); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e8e1d6); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--cream, #f9f2ea); border-color: var(--ink-faint, #a79c8e); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #2b2721); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Category Chip (active)
components.description: The selected Category. Ink fill, carrying aria-pressed="true".
components.css: .ds-chip-active { font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--ink, #2b2721); color: var(--surface, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #2b2721); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #2b2721); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: One catalog entry: thumbnail well, name, description, and a baseline row pairing the action label against a tabular-nums rate.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; gap: 12px; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e8e1d6); border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px; cursor: pointer; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-card:hover { background: var(--cream, #f9f2ea); border-color: var(--ink-faint, #a79c8e); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #2b2721); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-well { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 80px; height: 80px; flex-shrink: 0; background: var(--ground, #f5f1ea); border-radius: 12px; padding: 6px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-art { width: 100%; height: 100%; } .ds-card-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-card-name { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #2b2721); } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.375; color: var(--ink-muted, #6b6259); } .ds-card-foot { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-card-action { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-muted, #6b6259); } .ds-card-rate { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #2b2721); flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Product Card (selected)
components.description: Deliberately over-specified: Cream fill, Ink border plus ring, a drawn tick, and the words replacing the action label. Four signals for one state, because selection may never be carried by colour alone.
components.css: .ds-card-sel { display: flex; gap: 12px; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: var(--cream, #f9f2ea); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #2b2721); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--ink, #2b2721); border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px; cursor: pointer; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-sel:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #2b2721); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-sel-well { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 80px; height: 80px; flex-shrink: 0; background: var(--ground, #f5f1ea); border-radius: 12px; padding: 6px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-sel-art { width: 100%; height: 100%; } .ds-card-sel-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-card-sel-name { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #2b2721); } .ds-card-sel-desc { font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.375; color: var(--ink-muted, #6b6259); } .ds-card-sel-foot { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-card-sel-action { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink, #2b2721); } .ds-card-sel-tick { display: inline-block; width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-right: 4px; vertical-align: -2px; } .ds-card-sel-rate { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #2b2721); flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Concept Badge
components.description: Marks a Product Monis does not actually rent. Never ships without the sentence beside it — the badge alone does not carry the meaning.
components.html: ConceptNot rented by Monis today
components.css: .ds-concept { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-concept-pill { background: var(--signal, #63aefd); color: var(--ink, #2b2721); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; } .ds-concept-note { font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--ink-muted, #6b6259); }

components.name: Catalog Panel
components.description: The container the catalog lives in. Lifted by shadow, with no border — depth is declared once.
components.html: Demo pricing — invented for this concept, not a real Monis quote.
components.css: .ds-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); border-radius: 24px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 18px 46px -30px rgba(43,39,33,0.5); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-panel-chip, .ds-panel-chip-active { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e8e1d6); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink-muted, #6b6259); cursor: pointer; } .ds-panel-chip-active { background: var(--ink, #2b2721); color: var(--surface, #ffffff); border-color: var(--ink, #2b2721); } .ds-panel-note { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--ink-muted, #6b6259); margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: The only link treatment. Ink text with a faint underline that darkens on hover — the text colour never changes.
components.css: .ds-link { font: 500 0.875rem/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #2b2721); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--ink-faint, #a79c8e); text-underline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 4px; transition: text-decoration-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration-color: var(--ink, #2b2721); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #2b2721); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Wordmark Lockup
components.description: The header is a lockup, not a nav bar: an Ink tile carrying a cream desk glyph, the name, and the product line beneath it in tracked Label.
components.html: MonisWorkspace Designer
components.css: .ds-mark { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-mark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #2b2721); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-mark-tile { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; background: var(--ink, #2b2721); border-radius: 12px; } .ds-mark-glyph { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ds-mark-name { display: block; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--ink, #2b2721); } .ds-mark-sub { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 0.65rem; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: var(--ink-muted, #6b6259); }

components.name: Choice Pill
components.description: Picks one Area or one Cycle. The Category Chip's geometry over a real radio, because choosing is answering a question rather than performing an action: one tab stop per group, arrow keys between options, checked state announced.
components.css: .ds-pill-choice { position: relative; display: inline-block; font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink-muted, #6b6259); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e8e1d6); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-pill-choice input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; clip-path: inset(50%); } .ds-pill-choice:hover { background: var(--cream, #f9f2ea); border-color: var(--ink-faint, #a79c8e); } .ds-pill-choice:has(:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #2b2721); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Choice Pill (selected)
components.description: The chosen option. Ink fill, so the state survives a greyscale screenshot; the group's own label names what was chosen.
components.css: .ds-pill-choice-selected { position: relative; display: inline-block; font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--ink, #2b2721); color: var(--surface, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #2b2721); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pill-choice-selected input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; clip-path: inset(50%); } .ds-pill-choice-selected:has(:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #2b2721); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field Control
components.description: A native select or date input for choices too large or too structured to show at once. Only the closed control is restyled; the browser's picker is left alone. Text is 1rem so iOS does not zoom on focus, with the label above in Title and help text below in Caption.
components.html: Today or later. Same-day delivery is fine.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; font: 600 0.875rem/1.4 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #2b2721); margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-field { height: 40px; width: 100%; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #2b2721); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e8e1d6); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0 16px; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--ink-faint, #a79c8e); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #2b2721); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field-hint { font: 400 0.75rem/1.375 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-muted, #6b6259); margin-top: 8px; }

narrative.overview:
A rented villa in Bali, cleared out and turned into a showroom for a single afternoon. Warm light through a window, a terracotta rug, a rattan pendant overhead, and one desk set up in the middle of it so you can see what living with it would feel like. The furniture is real and the room is real; the paperwork on the side table is quiet, printed, and out of the way.

That split is the whole system. The room carries every colour in the product. The interface carries none. The scene is a 2.5D SVG full of oak, walnut, terracotta, rattan, and daylight — 40-odd hand-authored hues — and it sits inside chrome that is nothing but warm paper, ink, and a single hairline. Panels do not compete with the room; they hold it. Hierarchy in the chrome comes from space and font weight, never from a coloured accent, because the moment the interface reaches for a colour it starts arguing with the furniture.

The identity is Monis's own, taken from monis.rent rather than invented: Inter, near-black on near-white, full-round pills, hairline borders, and one soft cream fill. Two things are deliberately refused. It is not a corporate SaaS dashboard — the room is the hero and it is drawn, not charted. It is not interior-design realism either — the furniture reads as a clear, flat, confident illustration a rental company would ship, not as a render.
keyCharacteristics: Colour lives in the scene; the chrome is paper and ink
Warm neutrals throughout — no cool grey anywhere in the system
Depth from light, never from lines stacked on shadows
One oblique skew governs every horizontal plane in the room
Hairline borders and full-round pills, borrowed directly from Monis
Selected state always carries a mark and a word, never colour alone

rules.name: The Quiet Frame Rule
rules.body: Every saturated colour in this product belongs to the room. A hue appearing in the chrome is either the Concept signal or a mistake. The interface has ink, three papers, and a hairline — that is the entire budget.

rules.name: The Borrowed Signal Rule
rules.body: #63aefd marks exactly one thing: a product Monis does not rent. It is Monis's badge blue used against its usual meaning, and that inversion is load-bearing. It never becomes a general accent, a link colour, or a focus ring.

rules.name: The Warm-Only Rule
rules.body: No cool grey enters the chrome. Secondary text is #6b6259, not a neutral grey of the same lightness. On a cream ground a true grey reads as dirt.

rules.name: The Lockup-Only Rule
rules.body: Tracked uppercase at 0.2em is reserved for the wordmark lockup and the Concept badge. It never appears as an eyebrow or kicker above a heading — a heading carries its own weight.

rules.name: The Steady Figure Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change under the user's hands is tabular-nums. A live price that shifts sideways while you edit reads as instability in the price, not in the type.

rules.name: The Whole-Room Rule
rules.body: The scene's width is capped by the viewport height left over after the header and caption: max-width: calc((100dvh - 13rem) * 1.5). The room is the product, so it is never cropped and never scrolled past — it is sized to fit whole, and the chrome takes whatever is left.

rules.name: The Thumb-Rate Rule
rules.body: Below lg, the rail follows the whole scene and a compact read-only Setup rate stays fixed in the footer. The accessible setup panel remains the source of the live announcement and Cycle control; the footer adds no duplicate control or live region.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Lines Rule
rules.body: A surface declares depth exactly once. Lifted surfaces carry a shadow and no border; bordered surfaces carry a hairline and no shadow. A 1px ring under a wide soft shadow is the ghost-card tell and is banned outright.

rules.name: The One Oblique Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one skew in this product, and it comes from DESKTOP_ZONE's vectors. Any new horizontal plane derives its parallelogram from those vectors. A second, hand-guessed skew is how the scene starts looking broken.

dos: Do keep every saturated colour inside the scene's SVG. The chrome gets Ink, Ground, Surface, Cream, and Line.
Do cast shadows in Ink (rgba(43,39,33,…)), never in neutral black.
Do give a new horizontal plane its skew from DESKTOP_ZONE's u and v vectors.
Do pair every state that matters with a mark and a word, not just a fill — the PRD requires it and the system is built around it.
Do set changing figures in tabular-nums.
Do border a pill in both states so selection never shifts the layout.
Do size the scene from leftover viewport height so the room always fits whole.
Do keep touch targets at least 44px below lg while preserving desktop density from lg upward.
donts: Don't put a border and a shadow on the same surface.

Don't use #63aefd for anything except the Concept badge and text selection. It means "Monis does not rent this", and a second use dissolves that meaning. Known risk, accepted deliberately: blue is also Monis's badge colour for real products, so this badge can read as an endorsement at a glance. Its sentence is what disambiguates it — never ship the badge bare.
Don't set body copy in Ink Faint (#a79c8e). It is 2.7:1 on Surface and is for strokes and borders only.
Don't introduce a second typeface, or use tracked uppercase as an eyebrow above a heading.
Don't reach for a cool grey. Every neutral here is warm.
Don't apply a Zone's transform to an object's own group — translate to the projected point and draw upright.

Don't animate transforms inside the SVG. Per ADR-0001 they are not hardware-accelerated; transform motion belongs on div wrappers outside the scene, and motion inside it stays limited to opacity and attribute changes.
